entries.justification: Intentional difference, owner decision (Kevin, 2026-10-21, PR #295; docs/parity.md "Attachment cards: no floating Share / Download icons"). Web v1.21.12 shows a hover Download on image tiles (MessageImageGalleryAction) and a secondary Download on audio chips; file chips only carry a decorative Download/Eye glyph. Flutter has no floating Share or Download icon on any message attachment card (image and file cards): the card opens the viewer, where Download stays (preview header, media viewer; a file with no preview saves on tap). Share moves into the viewer headers (document, PDF, CSV/XLSX, markdown, text, HTML previews; image and video viewer), only on platforms with a share sheet. The audio card keeps its Download icon, as Web does, because it has no viewer to open.
entries.impact: Hovering or focusing an image or file card never reveals Share or Download; one tap opens the viewer and Download is there. Files with no preview (archives, code, diff/patch) save on tap and have no Share.
